description: Baseline curve panel for the in-house Gröbner (F4 / F5-style) engines. Every change to the engine code re-runs every cell below (tools/gb_baseline.py, .github/workflows/gb-baseline-rebench.yml) and regenerates the figures, REPORT.md and REPORT.pdf in this directory. Edit this file to add curves or m values; the workflow also re-runs when it changes.

curves.label: p = 2^31 - 1 (Mersenne prime), Dickson torus tower (2^t | p + 1)
